name: OnMessage
description:
OnMessage is where a company's messaging strategy lives: its audiences, offerings, brand foundation, narrative, voice, and writing guidelines, all maintained as a single source of truth instead of scattered across decks and documents.

This connector gives Claude live access to that Message Library. Instead of re-explaining the brand at the start of every conversation, Claude reads the approved strategy directly: who the audience is, what the offering actually does, which words the company uses and avoids. Then it writes from it.

Anyone who connects can browse, read, and search the files their OnMessage role already lets them see. People whose role carries edit access also get write tools: creating and editing workflow files, storing documents like transcripts and research reports into the library where they become searchable, and updating structured brand strategy such as offerings, audiences, personas, and glossary terms. Every write is versioned and reversible in the app.

Access mirrors OnMessage permissions exactly and is re-checked on every request, so the connector can never reach anything the same person could not reach while signed in. Agencies managing several client brands can list the organizations they have access to and switch between them, with the active brand named on every connection.

Requires an OnMessage account on a paid plan or an active trial.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OnMessage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OnMessage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.onmessage.ai/functions/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OnMessage MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OnMessage lists 29 MCP tools, including add_brand_pillar, add_glossary_term, create_audience, create_brand_voice, create_offering, create_persona, deactivate_audience, deactivate_offering, deactivate_persona, delete_library_file, edit_library_file, and get_library_guide.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OnMessage?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to OnMessage in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
OnMessage requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OnMessage is developed by OnMessage. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
